description: Defines a template-based message exchange mechanism with type-length-value serialization, including request, response, and buffer classes, as well as a core message exchange class with synchronization and data handling.

classes.name: TypeLengthValueType
classes.description: Template struct implementing type-length-value serialization with nested Request, Response, and Buffer classes.

classes.name: MessageExchangeType
classes.description: Core class managing message exchange with synchronization, data serialization, and request-response handling.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the request data into a stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream into internal buffer.

methods.name: ClaimSlot
methods.description: Claims a slot for a request, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends serialized request data over the connection.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data and processes incoming messages.
